title: Three numbers that keep getting repeated

cells: 88% of agent pilots never reach production
No identifiable primary publication supports this. It circulates via secondary blogs.
40% of agentic projects have already failed
Gartner's figure is a forecast for projects cancelled by end of 2027 — not an observed rate.
Semantic layers make agents less reliable
They surface more failures because they detect them. The source warns explicitly against reverse causation.

source: Corrections identified across Gartner, VentureBeat Pulse and secondary coverage, Sept 2026
